reason: Stream A (F2, F5, F6, F7, F8 objective call site) changes provider-chat context assembly in chat.py (_model_context, prepare_async, the context-length recovery rebuild, _with_tool_history's target via _estimate_limits, request capacity checks, routing-instruction helper, _persist's session write, context_status and runtime-switch preflight) and context.py helpers (source_digest, estimate_tool_definitions, calibration helpers, ContextStatus/ProviderRequestInput defaulted fields). Selected: the new assembly tests; the context/compactor tests (source_digest refactor, request estimate parts); test_chat.py (compaction, runtime switch, context recovery, exact session metadata); every file that asserts assembled compaction requests or snapshot reuse (project instructions, preflight latency, history content fidelity, turn outcome history, inference timeouts, model output budget); in-turn clearing and prompt-cache replay (calibrated target, checkpoint after excerpts); routing and synthesis requests (tool loop, synthesis declarations, subagents and agent messaging, whose routing instructions moved into one helper); session write counts (turn write amplification); goals (objective and compaction charging); chat leftovers (context recovery); chat API (context endpoint, runtime switch); mission compaction (orchestration, shared compactor digest). Counts from pytest --collect-only.
exclusions: No frontend, native or Playwright tests: no UI, Rust or visible behavior change (the context endpoint gains defaulted estimate_calibration and reserved_input_tokens fields and last_provider_request.reported_cached_input_tokens; the UI meter already reads estimated_input_tokens, whose accounting now includes tools and calibration). Provider adapter and prompt-caching tests are excluded: no adapter changed. Harness runtimes (Codex, Grok, Claude) own their context and never call _model_context. tests/v3/test_native_adapter_outcomes.py::test_responses_commentary_phase_is_reasoning_not_answer_text already fails on origin/main (unrelated) and is not selected. Real-Core evidence (OpenRouter deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash, two compactions, provider-reported cache hits, context endpoint) is recorded in the PR body. No full suite.
